portal_hypertension.title: Risk factors and predictive model for transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt dysfunction in cirrhotic patients.
portal_hypertension.authors: Zhao Y, Xiong T, Hu S
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：本研究旨在确定 TIPS 功能障碍的危险因素并开发预测模型来评估这种并发症。 临床提示：经颈静脉肝内门体分流术（TIPS）已被广泛用于治疗肝硬化患者失代偿性门静脉高压。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Transjugular intrahepatic portosystemic shunt (TIPS) has been widely adopted for the management of decompensated portal hypertension in cirrhotic patients. However, TIPS dysfunction remains a critical clinical challenge. This study aimed to identify risk factors for TIPS dysfunction and develop a predictive model to assess this complication. A retrospective study was conducted involving cirrhotic patients who underwent TIPS between 2017 and 2024. Among 1052 initially screened patients, 676 were finally included in the analysis. portal_hypertension.authors: Qureshi W, Hoang S, Frye J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：痔疮是一个常见问题。 临床提示：诊断和治疗可能具有挑战性。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Hemorrhoids are a common problem. The diagnosis and treatment can be challenging. Gastroenterologists have much to offer these patients.
